company.shortDescription: GrepData is a software company that gives consultation based on data models.
company.description:
With GrepData, turn your own Hadoop cluster directly into analytics and insight. All the processing happens right where the data is. Just install our highly optimized applications on the same boxes you already use for Hadoop and you're off and running.
 
All our applications are built 100% on top of distributed systems, allowing you to scale seamlessly from a thousand records a day to a billion records a day simply by adding commodity machines to your cluster. Never again worry about making another million dollar rack purchase from your BI vendor.
